findings.title: Malformed ERB `<%- end if %>` breaks template compilation
findings.body: The closing tag of the `if/else` at the top of the header is `<%- end if %>`. `end if` is not a valid way to close the block; the `if` modifier is left without a condition, so the template fails to compile. Any request that renders `embed/best` (the main embed path) would raise a template syntax error. The intended tag is presumably `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: RSS/Atom item HTML is unescaped and stored as raw, unsanitized post HTML
findings.body: `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` turns the feed's escaped markup back into real HTML, and `TopicEmbed.import` then stores it with `cook_method: raw_html`. `Post#cook` returns `raw` unchanged for raw_html posts, so the content skips the sanitizing pipeline and is rendered as-is by `best.html.erb` (`raw post.cooked`). A feed item containing `<script>` or event-handler attributes becomes stored XSS in the embedding page's iframe and the forum.

findings.title: Feed URL interpolated unescaped into HTML footer
findings.body: The `imported_from` footer is built with `"#{url}"`, where `url` comes from the feed and is only checked with a `^https?://` prefix. A URL containing `'`, `<` or `>` breaks out of the attribute or tag. Because the post is stored as raw_html and rendered unsanitized, this is a second injection path into the post body.

findings.title: Failed post creation is not detected before creating the TopicEmbed row
findings.body: `PostCreator#create` returns `@post` even when validation or spam checks fail (the post is unsaved, with errors). `if post.present?` is true in that case, so `TopicEmbed.create!` runs with `post.topic_id` possibly nil. This raises a NOT NULL database error or a validation error inside the background job, rather than cleanly returning nil. The check should be `post.present? && post.persisted?`.

findings.title: Feed items without content crash the whole poll
findings.body: `i.content.scrub` assumes every item has a `content` element. Feed items with only a `description`, or no body, return nil from SimpleRSS, so `nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError. That aborts the loop, and all remaining items in the feed are skipped on every hourly run.

findings.title: Each unknown embed URL triggers a synchronous full feed download
findings.body: `perform_retrieve` calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` whenever RSS polling is enabled and the URL is not yet known. That downloads and parses the entire feed and re-imports every item, with no timeout and no caching. Every distinct new URL repeats this work, so a burst of embed requests means many full feed fetches.

findings.title: Anonymous requests can queue unbounded retrieval jobs for arbitrary URLs
findings.body: For any unknown `embed_url`, `best` enqueues a `retrieve_topic` job. The 60-second throttle in `TopicRetriever` is keyed by the exact URL string, so each distinct query string or path on the embeddable host bypasses it. Anonymous clients can generate arbitrarily many fetch-and-create jobs against the forum and the embeddable site.

findings.title: setnx followed by expire is not atomic
findings.body: If the process dies between `$redis.setnx` and `$redis.expire`, the `retrieved:` key is left with no TTL. That URL is then throttled permanently. Use `SET key 1 EX 60 NX` or an equivalent single command.

findings.title: Check-then-insert race on topic embeds
findings.body: `TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` followed by a create is not safe under concurrency. Two jobs importing the same URL can both see no embed, and the second insert violates the unique index on `embed_url`, raising an exception after a duplicate topic and post have already been created in the transaction.

findings.title: X-Frame-Options 'ALLOWALL' is not a valid header value
findings.body: The valid values for X-Frame-Options are DENY and SAMEORIGIN (ALLOW-FROM is a non-standard variant). Browsers ignore unknown values, so the header has no effect. The iframe is actually allowed by the absence of a restrictive policy, and the header gives a false impression of a deliberate policy.

findings.title: postMessage origin check uses substring match instead of equality
findings.body: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` accepts any origin that is a substring of the Discourse URL, not only the exact origin. The check should compare the parsed origin of `discourseUrl` for equality with `e.origin`. The impact is limited to setting the iframe height, but the check is wrong as written.

findings.title: embed_url stored as varchar(255) with a unique index
findings.body: `t.string :embed_url, null: false` uses the default 255-character limit. Article URLs with long query strings or paths exceed this and fail on insert in PostgreSQL. Since the value is also the unique key, a longer text column or an explicit limit with validation is needed.

findings.title: create_table with force: true drops any existing table
findings.body: Changing `create_table :top_topics` to `force: true` makes the migration drop and recreate the table if it already exists, for example after a partial or repeated run. That silently discards existing top_topics data. The change is unrelated to the feature and should be reverted.

findings.title: Removed --category option without replacement or docs
findings.body: The `--category` option is removed, and the import no longer passes category or created_at to the post. Existing scripts that pass `-c` will fail with an unknown-option error, and imported posts silently lose their category and original timestamps. The removal is not mentioned in the PR and has no replacement.

findings.title: Test named 'is 404' does not test a 404 and passes for a different reason
findings.body: This example has no embeddable_host set and no referer, so it fails in `ensure_embeddable` with InvalidAccess before the `embed_url` parameter is checked. The name claims a 404 for a missing embed_url, but the missing-parameter path is never exercised.
